title: Elodie and the Songbook
author: Hazel Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Dunmore, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
